back squat.headline: Solid set — slight knee valgus in the hole
pos: Bar depth hit — hip below knee on all 3 reps
Consistent bar path right over midfoot
Good spinal control through the whole set
neg: Right knee caves in slightly on reps 2 and 3
Tempo accelerates out of the hole — losing tension
back squat.fix: Actively drive the knees out at the bottom ("spread the floor"). Hold a 1 sec pause at the bottom next set to rebuild tension.

deadlift.headline: Strong pull — hyperextension at the top
pos: Bar stays in contact with the body all the way up
Glutes and lats engaged from setup
Good pace — no hesitation at the knees
neg: Hips rise marginally before the shoulders
deadlift.fix: Lock out by squeezing the glutes, not by leaning back. Think "stand up" rather than "lean back" at the top.

default.headline: Technically solid — two minor adjustments
pos: Good control over the whole movement
Consistent ROM (range of motion) on every rep
neg: Slight asymmetry between left and right side
Bar path drifts a touch forward in the eccentric phase
default.fix: Film from the side next time to validate bar path. Consider a deload set on the weak side next session.
